sentence: Ice hockey, three against three: skaters, a puck, two goals, first to three goals wins. I play one skater with WASD and shoot with space.
title: Ice hockey, three against three

brief.rules: Two teams of three skaters, one puck, two goals. A puck that enters a goal scores for the other side; play restarts from the centre spot. The first side with three goals wins the match.
brief.arena: An indoor ice rink with boards and rounded corners, a goal at each end, a centre line, stands along one side.
brief.ai: Five computer skaters: two team-mates and three opponents. Each side keeps one skater back near its goal; the others chase, pass and shoot.
brief.controls: The player steers one home skater with W, A, S, D and shoots with space.
brief.mood: Bright arena light on pale glossy ice, two strong team colours, a horn and a light when a goal is scored.

packages.title: Rink, skaters, puck, goals, score and the match bot
packages.contract:
START FROM seeds/seed_paddle (ball, goals, score, an AI opponent, HUD) and work by analogy.
data/venue.json: a tl.layout/1 layout built with TLKit.build_layout: one kit `rink` (id rink), two kit `goal` parts (ids goal_home at -x, goal_away at +x), `stands`, a camera `broadcast`.
data/tuning.json: {skater_speed_mps, skater_accel, shot_impulse_ns, puck_radius_m, stick_reach_m}. data/rules.json: {sides: [home, away], goals_to_win: 3}.
scripts/main.gd: _pack_setup(ctx), _pack_start(), _pack_tick(frame), _pack_state() -> TLRules snapshot plus {puck: [x, z], skaters: [{id, side, pos: [x, z]}]}.
Six skaters (ids home_1..home_3, away_1..away_3), home_1 is the player's: input actions move_up, move_down, move_left, move_right (W, S, A, D) and shoot (space). The other five are steered through scripts/skater.gd: func steer(id: String, axis: Vector2, shoot: bool) -> void; until package `opponents` exists they chase the puck.
Score with TLRules (first to goals_to_win ends the match); a goal is the puck entering a goal's sensor. tests/bot_match.gd: plays home_1 until one side has three goals.

packages.title: Team AI for the five computer skaters
packages.contract:
data/ai.json: {reaction_frames, pass_chance, shoot_range_m, keeper_line_m}. scripts/team_ai.gd: func decide(state: Dictionary, id: String, tuning: Dictionary) -> Dictionary {axis: Vector2, shoot: bool}; scripts/main.gd loads it when the file exists and calls it once per frame for each computer skater, then skater.gd steer().
Roles: one skater per side stays near its own goal line (keeper_line_m), one chases the puck, one covers. No randomness outside ctx.rng.

packages.title: Ice, team colours, goal light, crowd sound
packages.contract:
data/look.json: {home_colour, away_colour, ice_gloss, goal_flash_frames}. scripts/look.gd: func apply(ctx, nodes: Dictionary) -> void (called by main.gd after the layout is built when the file exists): team colours on the skaters, a glossy ice skin, centre line and circles, a light flash and a horn when a side scores (TLRules signal), crowd loop.
gen/look.gd: the rink markings as one generated mesh. Must change what the `broadcast` camera sees.
